# Render options — the declared vocabulary

A render option changes how a scene is DRAWN (glow, god-rays, shape, a post-process filter) and never the
physics. Each renderer DECLARES the options it can honour through `renderCapabilities()`; this page is
generated from those declarations, so it lists exactly what each renderer accepts.

Set them in one call, in a recipe or on a live runner:

```js
exp.render({ shape: 'sphere', godrays: 0.8, glowIntensity: 1.6 });       // in buildExperiment(exp)
runner.setRenderOptions({ 'filter.water': 1, renderBaseCanvas: false }); // on a live runner
runner.setRenderOption('heat', 0.35);                                     // one option
```

`bootScene(mount, sketch, { render: { … } })` takes the same bag. The write is **throw-or-apply**:

- a key the active renderer does not declare throws, naming the declared list. `godRays` is a typo and
  throws; `godrays` on the p5 renderer throws, because p5 has no god-rays pass;
- a value outside its declaration (out of range, not a listed value) throws;
- a bag with one bad key applies nothing;
- written before the renderer attaches, the bag is checked the moment it attaches.

Read the live list with `runner.renderCapabilities()`, and one value with `runner.getRenderOption(name)`.
Every still records the value of each declared option (except `filter.*`, which the still records as
`filtersApplied`) in `still.renderOptions`.

`filter.<name>` toggles a post-process pass on or off; several filters can be on at once.

## three.js renderer (`three`)

Declared only here: `godrays`, `godrayDensity`, `godraySource`, `glowIntensity`, `heat`, `smoke`, `mesh`, `meshScale`.

| Option | Accepts | Default | Unit | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `shape` | one of `ball`, `box`, `circle`, `cube`, `sphere` | `"ball"` |  | Render-level DEFAULT particle shape (RenderShape.js — the one shape authority). A per-object sugar override (e.g. a SphereEmitter renderShape) wins per-leaf via the render.shape key; this is the fallback when none is set. |
| `colorScheme` | one of `roygbiv`, `warmcool` | `"warmcool"` |  | Per-experiment default fullness-to-color ramp (LightColor.js — the one color authority). |
| `renderBaseCanvas` | boolean (a control's `0`/`1` is coerced) | `true` |  | Whether the particle/base layer composites into the scene before any post-process pass (README §3). Both p5 and three honor this identically; the write gate coerces a 0/1 control value to the boolean the providers read. |
| `godrays` | number (0 to 3) | `0` | intensity | God-rays post-process composite intensity (three-only final-composite layer). |
| `godrayDensity` | number (0.2 to 1.5) | `0.8` | density | God-rays radial-blur density/spread (only consulted when godrays > 0). |
| `godraySource` | one of `leaf`, `all` | `"leaf"` |  | What the god-rays are computed from: 'leaf' = the fundamental-layer frames (LOs only occlude), 'all' = the whole lit scene (every frame of every layer and every LO). |
| `glowIntensity` | number (0 to 3) | `0` | intensity | Per-dim glow-layer intensity multiplier (R4-GEO additive glow shading). |
| `heat` | number (0 to 1) | `0` | 0-1 | Heat-ramp shift: warms dense-quanta color toward the hot end of the scheme. |
| `smoke` | number (0 to 16) | `0` | intensity | Smoke-puff layer intensity (per-dim greyscale+soft paint gate). |
| `mesh` | string | `null` |  | Scene-default external glTF asset id (URL) every frame is drawn as, in 3D. OPEN-ID like its per-frame twin render.mesh; unset draws the shape path. |
| `meshScale` | number (0.01 to 100) | `1` | multiplier | Scene-wide scale multiplier for external-mesh clones (a frame's render.meshScale overrides it per frame). |
| `filter.water` | boolean (a control's `0`/`1` is coerced) | `false` |  | Toggle the "water" post-process filter (Filters.js — the runner routes the write to filter()/removeFilter(); a 0/1 control value is coerced to the boolean). |
| `filter.bloom` | boolean (a control's `0`/`1` is coerced) | `false` |  | Toggle the "bloom" post-process filter (Filters.js — the runner routes the write to filter()/removeFilter(); a 0/1 control value is coerced to the boolean). |
